478.0: Find a comfortable position. Sit, or lie down. Let the jaw loosen.
478.55: If counting feels like work, just make the out-breath longer than the in.
478.120: Halfway. You are not trying to fall asleep. Just a little slower than you were.
478.190: A few more. If the mind is busy, let it be. Keep the breath ordinary.
478.235: You can stop counting. If you are sleepy, stay with that. If not, keep the room dim.

body-scan.0: Lights can stay low. Close your eyes, if that is easy.
body-scan.22: Feel the weight of your body on the bed. No need to change it.
body-scan.50: The forehead. Let those small muscles rest.
body-scan.80: The jaw. Tongue away from the roof of the mouth. A little space between the teeth.
body-scan.115: Neck and shoulders. Heavy. They do not have to hold anything right now.
body-scan.155: The arms. Left, then right. Hands. Fingers. Nothing to hold on to.
body-scan.195: The chest. Let the breath move without managing it.
body-scan.245: The belly. Let it be soft.
body-scan.290: Hips and low back. Heavy into the bed.
body-scan.340: Thighs, knees, calves. Ordinary. That is all right.
body-scan.395: The feet. Let them be still.
body-scan.435: The whole body, as one. If you drift, that is good. If you do not, that is good too. Stay off the clock.
body-scan.470: That is enough. If you are sleepy, stay. If you are still wired, get up, keep it dim, until sleepiness comes.

pmr.0: We will tighten one area, then let it go. Easy. Never into pain.
pmr.14: Hands. Soft fists for a few seconds... and let them go.
pmr.22: Now let the hands go. Soft.
pmr.38: The arms. A gentle curl... and release.
pmr.46: Now let the arms go. Soft.
pmr.62: Shoulders. Up toward the ears... and let them hang.
pmr.70: Now let the shoulders hang down.
pmr.88: The face. A light squeeze... and smooth.
pmr.96: Smooth the face. Nothing is held.
pmr.118: Chest and back. A small stretch... and release.
pmr.126: Now let the stretch go. Soft.
pmr.152: The belly. Draw in gently... and let it go.
pmr.160: Now let the belly go. Soft.
pmr.188: Thighs. Press into the bed... and release.
pmr.196: Now let the legs go. Soft.
pmr.228: Calves and feet. Point, then flex... and stop.
pmr.238: Stop. Let the feet be heavy.
pmr.258: The whole body, heavy. No more tensing.
pmr.305: Rest in that warmth. That is the point.
pmr.345: Done. Dim and quiet from here.
